Name: Kimberly's Crib Replacement and Recolours for Content Patcher
Author: bonecharm
Description:
This mod is a Content Patcher partial conversion of Kimberly's Witch Kitchen Bed Bathroom Crib mod. [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/kimberlys-witch-kitchen-bed-bathroom-crib.136301/]Original found here[/url].

This mod contains the crib only. If the original creator would like me to take this down, please let me know!

It comes with a config.json file that you change the values of as below
cribcolour - default, lightbrown, darkbrown
sheetcolour - default, blue, green, pink, red, yellow

The crib comes in 18 different styles, [b]3 different wood colours[/b] and [b]6 different bed sheets[/b] for each wood colour.

[b]Wood[/b]
Default (White)
Light Brown
Dark Brown

[b]Bed Sheets[/b]
Default (Purple)
Blue
Green
Pink
Red
Yellow
